content: SLEEP –  Notes/Objectives Objective:   Tell the story of The Second Age of Man through the eyes of four characters.  Marcus Gavin:   Marcus is a member of the ARC project, because one of the ships malfunctioned a small set of the original members land scattered throughout time after the second age. Marcus navigates this new world, discovering his powers and learning about the order of people like him.  He is being hunted by the Queen for his blood and as a resource, he is being hunted by the newly reformed sword of the faithful to kill. All while trying to come to terms with his new existence.   Lorin Corliss:   Corliss is a Warden  a group sanctioned by the monarchy, like state police, they investigate, retrieve fugitives and maintain the law over and above the single territory. Corliss is the daughter of Galen, they are estranged. She is tasked to hunt Marcus by the queen and has to deal with her father, her father is killed, and the wardens are disbanded, leaving Corliss in a bad place. Uri is the Lord Adjudicator and her mentor.   Veric Nero :   Messenger Veric Nero is a  good man and a priest, a messenger of Aurtus, he presides over the Aurtus keep in the small village where Orah lives, he knows Orah and her tragic story, he and Marcus becomes friends, when Rogan moves in and begins to kill people, as the queen begins to take over the territory and disband her advisors and the lords, he realizes that those with powers can be evil, he goes to the church and finds the old tomes on the sword of the faithful, he resurrects the order and begins to build them up, he will be forced to find and hunt Marcus before the queen finds him and he will prepare to go head to head with the Queen.  Juric Rogan :   Juric is the Queen’s chancellor, she hand picked him, taking him out of an abusive house and basically raising him, Juric has total loyalty to the queen, she guides him to her secret projects and he discovers what she is up to , he listens to her and then become s the first of her chosen  , those who run the territory in her name. She, like Marcus was a member of ARC, she is a source Mage with incredible power and has spent twenty years researching how to make herself and her followers more powerful.
